tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ klong chen snying gi thig le las: gcod yul mkha' 'gro'i gad rgyang bzhugs:

dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ni: nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: gcad bya gcod byed las 'das kyang : spros pa can gyi gang zag dang : brtul zhugs spyod pa lam slong phyir: phung po gzan bskyur man ngag bstan: de la mkho ba'i yo byad ni: dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: sder bzhi ma nyams gcan gzan lpags: lta ba yas 'bubs cog pu dang : spyod pa mas 'dzegs kha ṭāṃ ka: lha 'dre dbang sdud mchog chen rkang : snang ba zil gnon ḍā ma ru: ma tshogs dbang sgyur dril g.yer dang : stag gzig ras ma skra'i cod pan: mdor na brtul zhugs spyod pa la: 'os pa'i chas rnams sta gon bya: de nas sa gnad gnyan dmigs su: pho tshod lha 'drer brnyas sems dang : chos brgyad bsam pas ma yin par: tshad med bzhi yis dpa' gdeng bskyed: snang ba gang shar thog brdzis bya: de tshe zil gnon dmigs pa yis: ma gcun dgra la bya shor mtshungs: de phyir rig pa brtul zhugs ngang : phaṭaḥces rang gi snying ga nas: gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa: sra brtan lci zhing 'thas pa la: 'od zer me dpung 'bar ba zhig: gang dmigs gnyan sar thog ltar phob: der gnas lha 'dre dpung dang bcas: 'bros shing 'khyer ba'i dbang med par: dpa' zil chag ste gnas par bsam: de nas tshul 'chos ngo tsha sogs: tha mal 'khu 'phrigs blo spangs la: brtul zhugs ngar ma'i gdeng ldan pas: 'gro lugs rnam pa bzhi dag las: lta ba'i gdeng 'gros shugs kyis 'gro: de yang snang srid lha 'dre dang : gnas gdon lam 'dre 'khyam po kun: bkug la ra lug bdas pa bzhin: gnyan sar rang dbang med par gcur: gnas der slebs ma thag nyid du: drag shul 'bar ba'i stangs stabs kyis: lha 'dre kun gyi rkang pa nas: bzung ste klad la lan gsum bskor: dbang chen gzhi la brdab par bsam: cog pu stan bcas shugs kyis bskyur: lha 'dre ji ltar dbyings che yang :

mi lhongs mi srid zi khol 'gro: rnal 'byor brtul zhugs chung gyur na: rim pas blo dang sbyar te bya: de nas rang nyid skad cig gis: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: che chung srid pa'i gtos dang mnyam: rnam 'gyur rdzogs pa'i skur bskyed la: mi rkang gling bu drag tu 'bud: lta ba'i ngar bskyed bro brdung bya: phaṭaḥ 'jigs med brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor nga : 'khor 'das mnyam par brdal ba'i dgongs spyod kyis: bdag 'dzin lha 'dre'i steng du bro zhig brdung : gnyis 'dzin 'khor ba'i rnam rtog rdul du rlog: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma bro la byon: yi dam dpa' bo rgya mtsho bro la byon: mkha' 'gro gnas nyul ma tshogs bro la byon: brtul zhugs lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs: phaṭaḥ shar phyogs lus 'phags gling du brdungs tsa na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zlum la 'khyil: zhe sdang rgyal po'i mgo la chems se chem: me long ye shes gling bu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭaḥ lho yi 'dzam bu'i gling du brdungs tsa na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zur gsum dbal: nga rgyal gshin rje'i mgo la chems se chem: mnyam nyid ye shes thod rnga khro lo lo: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭaḥ nub kyi ba lang spyod la brdungs tsa na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zla gam 'khyil: 'dod chags srin mo'i mgo la chems se chem: sor rtog ye shes dril g.yer khro lo lo: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭaḥ byang gi sgra mi snyan la brdungs tsa na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra gru bzhi lam: phrag dog dam sri'i mgo la chems se chem: bya grub ye shes cod pan pu ru ru: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭaḥ dbus phyogs lhun po'i rtse ru brdungs tsa na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bro ra byin re chags: gti mug shi 'dre'i mgo la chems se chem: chos dbyings ye shes hūm̐ glu kyu ru ru: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭaḥ ces brdung shes pa gtad med btang :

de nas cog pu 'bub pa ni: gzhi de'i lha 'dre gdug pa can: gan rkyal bsgyel ba'i yan lag lngar: gnam lcags phur bu btab par bsam: phaṭaḥ shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gro mas: byams pa chen po'i phur pa khyer: lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gro mas: snying rje chen po'i phur pa khyer: nub phyogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro mas: dga' ba chen po'i phur pa khyer: byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro mas: btang snyoms chen po'i phur pa khyer: dbus phyogs sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas: byang chub sems kyi phur pa khyer: bdag 'dzin lha 'dre'i mgo bo dang : lhu tshigs bzhi la btab pa yis: g.yo 'gul med par gnas par gyur: phaṭaḥ ces brjod bdag gzhan lha 'dre gsum: gang du mi dmigs mnyam par bzhag: de nas lha 'dre ngos zin nas: lus sbyin dngos la 'jug pa ni: phaṭaḥ rang snang 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i dbyings: 'bad rtsol spros pa bral ba'i nam mkha' la: rtsa ba'i bla ma drug pa rdo rje 'chang : dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin ltar gtibs: ma 'gags 'ja' tshon thig le'i klong du gsal: zhes pas tshogs zhing gsal btab la: lha 'dres gtso byas sems can kun: khyed shes blo yis skyabs 'gror dmigs: phaṭaḥ rang byung gi rig pa bcos med 'di: skyabs yul gyi ngo bor ma rig pa'i: sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byings pa rnams: sku gsum gyi dgongs pas bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum de nas sems bskyed ni: phaṭaḥ snang ba la dngos por 'dzin pa'i sems: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas tshar bcad nas: yang dag gi gnas lugs rtogs bya'i phyir: re dwogs dang bral bar sems bskyed do: de nas maṇ+ḍal ni: khog pa ri rab: yan lag gling bzhi: nying lag gling phran: mgo bo lha gnas: mig gnyis nyi zla: don snod lha mi'i dpal 'byor du bsams la: phaṭaḥ gces 'dzin gyi phung po sgyu ma'i lus: maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bur rab bkod nas:

tshogs zhing gi lha la ltos med 'bul: bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod par shog: phaṭaḥ de nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni: phaṭaḥ dbyings zag med chos sku'i nam mkha' la: mdangs 'ja' zer thig le 'khrugs pa'i dbus: pha dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma 'byung : tshul brtul zhugs spyod pa'i he ru ka: ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: sku mtshan dpe'i gzi byin ta la la: gsung gang 'dul chos sgra 'u ru ru: thugs 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ngang : bu mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs: phyi rnam rtog dgrar langs lha 'dre'i gzugs: nang re dang dogs pa'i gnyis 'dzin sems: bar snang ba sna tshogs rkyen ngan kun: chos zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul gyis: dus da lta stan thog 'di ru chod: dbyings chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa ru: pha rje btsun bla mas byin gyis rlobs: phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ces brjod tshogs zhing rang la bstim: gnyis med ngang du mnyam par bzhag: phaṭaḥ de nas bag chags snyigs ma'i lus: tsho zhing snum la ltos che ba'i: dbus nas dwangs ma'i rig pa ni: khros ma'i rnam par phaṭaḥces dbye: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod can: de yis rang lus thod pa phral: stong khams khyab pa'i mi mgo yi: sgyed pu gsum gyi khar bzhag nang : 'byung lus tshogs su bshams pa de: 'bru gsum 'od kyis bdud rtsir sbar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ha ho hrīḥ ci mang brjod pas sbyang spel bsgyur: khra bor 'gyed na de nyid las: skyed tshal zas gos sman la sogs: yid la ci 'dod ngo bor sbar: dmar 'gyed rang nyid khros mar gsal: snyigs ma'i lus kyi pags bshus nas: stong gsum khyab par bkram pa'i steng : gzugs phung sha khrag phung por spungs: shan pa'i mdun sa lta bur bsam: nag 'gyed bdag gzhan sems can gyi: thog med nas bsags nad gdon dang : sdig sgrib thams cad nag bun gyis: bsdus te gzugs phung la bstim pa: lha 'dres zos pas kho'i lus: sol ba lta bur gyur par bsam:

mchod sbyin mgron rnams 'di ltar 'bod: phaṭaḥ mchod yul rtsa gsum man chad nas: sde brgyad 'byung pos gtso byas pa'i: sbyin yul lan chags 'dre gdon yan: brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gnas 'dir byon: de ring 'jigs med rnal 'byor ngas: 'khor 'das shan 'byed sgyu ma'i lus: stong gsum khyon yangs ka pā lar: bam chen tshogs kyi 'khor lor bshams: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: 'dod dgur 'char ba'i cho 'phrul can: gces 'dzin med par 'bul lags kyi: ston chen mgron la gshegs su gsol: mchog chen thod rnga skad re gsangs: zhing chen g.yang gzhi brjid re cheḥ mi rkang gling du gdangs re snyan: dril g.yer cod pan dngas re spro: bya rgod sha la 'thib pa bzhin: skad cig nyid la gshegs su gsol: phaṭaḥ de nas 'bul zhing bsngo ba ni: phaṭaḥ gdod ma'i mgon po man chad nas: rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma dang : yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la: bam chen bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: lha 'dres gtso byas bdag gzhan gyi: tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis byang : brtul zhugs 'gro don mthar phyin nas: snang ba 'od gsal sgyu mar 'byongs: ya nga bag tsha chos skur grol: he ru ka ltar byin gyis rlobs: phaṭaḥ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: sde brgyad 'byung po mi ma yin: log 'dren sha za'i gdon tshogs la: stong gsum khyab pa'i zhing lpags steng : sha khrag rus pa'i phung por 'bul: bdag tu 'dzin na nga re zhan: spyod du ma nus khyod re lod: ring na rjen par khyur mid thongs: lhod na dal bur tshos la zo: rdul phran tsam yang ma bzhag cig: phaṭaḥ 'khor tshe thog ma med pa nas: sha 'khon chags pa'i lan chags dang : glo bur lhags pa'i snying rje'i mgron: khas nyan dbang chung ma lus la: so so gang la ci 'dod kyi: 'dod yon mi zad gter du bsngo: 'brel ba thogs tshad sangs rgyas shing : bu lon lan chags byang bar shog:

phaṭaḥ ces brjod ltos pa med par byin: stong nyid ngang la mnyam par bzhag: de tshe lus la gces 'dzin dang : 'jigs snang 'khu 'phrigs blo skyes na: lus ni lha 'drer byin nas med: sems ni gzhi med rtsa ba bral: 'dre bas sangs rgyas nyid kyis kyang : gzigs pa med snyam gdeng bskyed la: gang shar rang ngo rtsa gdar bcad: thogs bcas bdud dang phyi rkyen 'byung ba dang gcan gzan mi rgod sogs dang chags sdang gi rnam rtog sogs/ thogs med bdud:nang rkyen dga' sdug sems tshig la sogs/ dga' brod bdud dang rang mthong bde skyid mngon rlom sogs/ bsnyengs byed bdud:the tshom dang khu 'phrigs la sogs/ phaṭaḥces dbyings su gcod pa yin: de yang dus tshod la mtshon na: tho rangs tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i phyir: dkar 'gyed bdud rtsi'i ngo bor spar: nyin gung lan chags sbyang ba'i phyir: khra 'gyed gang la 'tshams par bsngo: nub mo brtul zhugs lam slong phyir: bdag 'dzin tshar gcod dmar 'gyed gtong : srod la sdig sbyong nag 'gyed bya: kun kyang 'dun pas bsgyur ba ste: gtso bo dmigs pas nyams su blang : de tshe cho 'phrul ci byung yang : nyams dang bral ba'i lta bas gcun: gal te rnal 'byor dbyings chung nas: lhongs 'tshubs 'chun par dka' ba'am: lha 'dre dbyings che ma lhongs na: keng rus dkar po'i dmigs pa bya: phaṭaḥces rang nyid skad cig gis: keng rus dkar po me 'bar ba: shin tu che bo las byung ba'i: me yis stong gi 'jig rten dang : khyad par lha 'dre'i gnas rten bsregs: mthar ni keng rus me dang bcas: 'od yal stong pa'i ngang la gzhag: 'go nad srung ba la yang zab: tshar tshad dus su ma byung dang : gnod 'dre gdug pa ar gtod na: rig pa khros ma'i skur gsal bas: snyigs ma'i lus kyi pags pa bshus: stong gsum khengs pa'i g.yang gzhi'i steng : sha rus gcal du bkram pa la: 'dre gdon zas la gdung pa'i mod: khros mas g.yang gzhi 'ub kyis dril:

sbrul dang rgyu ma'i zhags pas bsdams: klad la bskor zhing brdabs pa yis: sha myag rus myog dag tu song : sprul pa'i gcan gzan du ma yis: lhag ma med par zos par bsam: dbyings rig bsres te mnyam par gzhag: des ni tshar tshad nges 'byung zhing : 'dre gdon gdug pa tshar chod 'gyur: kun la gces 'dzin blo spangs te: lta ba'i gdeng gis zin pa gces: de tshe tshar tshad 'dra ba'i lhongs: lhongs tshad 'dra ba'i tshar tshad dang : gnyis ka 'dra ba'i 'dres ma dang : 'dres ma 'dra ba'i bag chags dang : tshar lhongs gnyis ka mthar phyin gyi: rtags rnams nyams dang sbyar te spyad: don la bdag med kun bzang mo: yum chen shes rab phar phyin ma'i: dgongs pa klong du gyur tsa na: gcod yul lam du longs pa'o: sa ma ya: rjes la bsngo smon bya ba ni: āḥ dge dang mi dge'i rtog tshogs rang grol la: re dang dogs pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang : snang cha'i rten 'brel bslu med dge tshogs rgyun: zag med chos kyi dbyings su bsngo bar bya: phaṭaḥ kun rdzob lus kyi sbyin pa la brten nas: bskal par bsags pa'i bu lon lan chags byang : don dam chos kyi bden pas rgyud 'grol tshe: bdag gi 'dus pa dang por skye bar shog: de tshe ma bcos rang gzhag gnyug ma'i don: mi bsrun lha 'dre'i rgyud la skyes nas kyang : ngar 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rjes su mi 'brang bar: byams dang snying rjes shes rgyud brlan par shog: bdag kyang brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin nas: skyid sdug ro snyoms 'khor 'das chos skur 'byongs: phyogs las rnam rgyal 'brel tshad don ldan gyis: phrin las mthar phyin 'ja' lus 'grub par shog: phaṭaḥ ces brjod lta ba'i ngang mdangs bskyangs: snying rje chen po'i rtsis zin pas: bde sdug bdag gi bde ba lha 'drer btang*/ gtong lha 'dre'i sdug bsngal rang gis blang*/ len dmigs pa dang : chos kyi sbyin pa rnam dag bya:chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/
sogs dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ sogs dang*/ 'byung po gang dag sogs kyi shis brjod bya'o// 'brel thogs bzang ngan thar lam 'god: sa ma ya: ma ma ko ling sa man+ta:/// /
